method: linear least squares per guide against htmlSize * scale; rounded once for display
notes: User confirmed the size comparison. Manual guide positions from FONT_REPORT, Ubuntu Regular, LineHeight=1, H x p. Coordinates from TextLabel top downward. robloxTextSize preserves the actual stored size; formulas use requested size, matching the existing guide API. Maximum rounded training error 1 px. No held-out validation; other sizes remain estimates. Baseline minus Top is a guide distance, not an independently counted glyph pixel height.
